capabilities: assign SVG icons to individual notes
assign SVG icons to folders in the file explorer
assign SVG icons to Make.md Spaces via context menu
bulk-assign one icon to multiple selected Make.md items
browse and pick icons in a searchable, paginated grid
disambiguation: Not an icon pack or theme; you supply your own SVG files from a vault folder and the plugin assigns them to items.
extras: The README warns that the Make.md integration relies on internal APIs that may change in future Make.md updates and may need adjustments after major updates. Installation is manual only (copy files into .obsidian/plugins/); no community plugin store install is described.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer and notes have no built-in way to attach custom visual icons for organizing a vault visually.

relations.evidence: Uses Make.md's runtime API to assign and restore icons.

summary: Icon assignment plugin that lets you apply custom SVG icons from your vault to notes, folders, and Make.md Spaces.
